scope: Direct proof of the T3 top-three formula and its fixed-Q use in 121; not a new input family or reviewer verdict.
exact_T3_spectrum: For any actual four-qubit density, E_bar_i erasing all sites except i gives T3=(1/8)sum_i rho_i tensor I_bar_i. Choose local eigenbases independently for the four one-qubit marginals rho_i=(I+r_i sigma_ni)/2. The four terms commute in the product eigenbasis and have eigenvalues (1+-r_i)/16 on each coordinate after the factor I_bar_i/8. Hence spec(T3)={(4+sum_i epsilon_i r_i)/16: epsilon_i=+-1}, including all multiplicities and ties.
top_three: For 0<=r1<=r2<=r3<=r4, the maximum signed sum is all +. The next two largest are obtained by flipping one of the two smallest radii, i.e. sums minus 2r1 or minus 2r2; any other distinct sign pattern has subtractive cost at least 2r2 or uses a larger flip. Thus K3(T3)=(12+3sum r_i-2r1-2r2)/16=(12+r1+r2+3r3+3r4)/16=(12+L)/16. When radii tie or vanish, the chosen eigenvalues may be degenerate, but their sum is unchanged.
fixed_Q_bound: Every actual rank-three Q satisfies Tr(QT3)<=K3(T3), hence 5/4-Tr(QT3)>=(8-L)/16. Equality in this displayed fixed-Q inequality requires Q to maximize T3; equality of the bound 5/4 itself requires L=8, i.e. all local radii one and the input a pure product. Mixed inputs can have L=8 only if every local marginal is pure, which forces a pure product by local support factorization.
endpoint_and_noise: This T3 bound is a coefficient in the positive-shrink erasure comparison only. Negative shrink is handled after the exact full-transpose spinflip mapping of Q, not by inserting negative coefficients. The p=0 coefficient of T3 is zero, consistent with identity-channel equality being governed by support-in-Q.
process: Author-only; no independent review, harmonic all-state proof, global k3 or novelty. Five 121 corrections, two cadence findings, 147 phase-message history and 149 projected-rank withdrawal remain.
